title: Public reply about reversed charges and finance-charge adjustment
discussion_signal: The public bank-support reply says charges were reversed and finance charges adjusted after a customer complaint. It shows a public-facing support account providing a case-specific response, while the underlying complaint and final customer outcome are not fully visible.
linked_research_question: When a public support route produces a response, does it provide a genuine remedy and trust repair, or only a visible case-level explanation?
limits: Public reply is an organizational claim
Customer identity and original complaint are not exposed in the indexed page
Resolution is not independently verified and the example is outside the US consumer setting
